name: Oxus region
summary: The Amu Darya/Oxus frontier region near where Alp Arslan was mortally wounded in 1072.
overview: The Oxus region refers broadly to the frontier around the Amu Darya, known in classical and medieval geography as the Oxus.
Alp Arslan was mortally wounded in this frontier context in 1072 while campaigning east of the main Seljuk heartlands.

imageInfo.caption: The Amu Darya (Oxus), the great river of Central Asia that defined the Oxus frontier region.
imageInfo.creator: Science and Analysis Laboratory, NASA-Johnson Space Center.
imageInfo.note: Modern photograph of the place or a surviving historical site there.

contentSections.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Oxus formed a major geographic boundary in Central Asian and Islamic history, linking Transoxiana, Khurasan, and steppe-frontier politics.

contentSections.title: Medieval historical context
paragraphs: Alp Arslan died after being wounded by a captive or defeated opponent during an eastern campaign. The exact local details vary in narrative sources, so IronCodex uses the broader Oxus region cautiously.

contentSections.title: Legacy
paragraphs: The place matters here because the death of a victorious sultan came not in Anatolia after Manzikert but on the empire’s eastern frontier.
